informational.text: A `ds-table` header button (sort or definition term) takes a pointer target at least `--hit-xs` tall through a transparent `::before`; its focus ring stays on the label.
informational.verify: Point just above the text of a sortable `ds-table` header: the pointer becomes a hand a few pixels before it reaches the letters, and a click there sorts the column.

informational.text: A `ds-avatar` whose `imageUrl` fails to load shows `initials`, or `fallbackIcon`, in place of the image until `imageUrl` changes; a new URL is tried again.
informational.verify: Bind `imageUrl` to an address that answers 404 on a `ds-avatar` with `initials`: the initials are drawn on the tint, and binding a working URL afterwards shows the image.
